title: Custom Software Development Firms
tagline: Overflow engineering that never touches your client relationship.
summary: Boutique software houses and digital consultancies win work faster than they can staff it. We act as the second squad behind your brand — same standards, your repository, your client never hears our name unless you want them to.
pains: Bench swings between sold projects and signed contracts
Senior engineers pulled off delivery to support sales
Fixed-price estimates that need a second team to hold
offers: White-label squads under your brand and process
Fixed-scope modules with written acceptance criteria
NDA-first delivery in your repo, tools and ceremonies

title: SaaS Product Companies
tagline: Ship the roadmap you sold, with a pod that already knows your stack.
summary: Product teams get stuck between a hiring freeze and a roadmap the board has already seen. We plug in as a feature pod for one or two quarters, take ownership of a surface, and leave documentation your team can run without us.
pains: Roadmap blocked by hiring and onboarding lag
Billing, auth or import layers nobody wants to touch
Trial onboarding that leaks activation every month
offers: Feature pods releasing every two weeks
Re-platform and migration work on legacy surfaces

title: Digital Marketing Agencies
tagline: Campaign sites and microsites that land inside the launch date.
summary: Campaign calendars do not move for development queues. We build landing pages, microsites and tracking implementations to your creative direction, then hand over a CMS your account team can edit without raising a ticket.
pains: Dev capacity booked out for the whole campaign cycle
CRO and copy changes waiting on a developer
Landing pages failing Core Web Vitals on mobile
offers: Landing page and microsite builds at campaign speed
CMS handover your account team can actually edit

title: UI/UX Design Studios
tagline: Your design, engineered faithfully — state for state.
summary: Design intent usually dies in handoff. We implement to your Figma, including the empty, loading, error and disabled states that never make it into the deck, and we document the components so the next feature is cheaper than the last.
pains: Design intent lost between prototype and production
No engineering partner for design-system work
Prototypes that need real data to convince stakeholders
offers: Front-end engineering to your Figma specifications
Accessible component libraries at WCAG 2.2 AA

title: Cloud & DevOps Consultancies
tagline: Platform work delivered by engineers who read the runbook.
summary: Assessments are easy to sell and hard to execute when the client wants the findings closed this quarter. We provide the hands for migrations, Terraform modules and observability so your recommendation becomes a delivered outcome.
pains: Migration windows slipping while assessments age
Infrastructure-as-code drift with no named owner
Audit findings with no capacity to close them
offers: Terraform module builds and landing zones
